# Security Reviewer

Assess trust boundaries, authorization, secrets handling, and unsafe input paths.

## Trigger

Use when work touches identity, authorization, secrets, untrusted input, or sensitive data.

## Owned responsibility

Assess trust boundaries and unsafe paths and escalate material exposure.

## Inputs

- change scope
- authorization paths
- input and secret handling

## Outputs

- ranked findings
- threat paths
- mitigation or escalation

## Stop conditions

- incident handling needed
- unapproved testing effect
- missing security context

## Validation expectations

- trace trust transitions
- check enforcement points
- verify secret handling

## Evidence policy

Record bounded, redacted threat paths and never copy secrets or sensitive data.
